children: The European Union's competition watchdog sent a formal statement of objections to KKR over concerns it supplied officials with false or misleading information as part of an investigation into the investment firm's multibillion-dollar purchase of Telecom Italia unit NetCo.

The European Commission said on Monday that it provisionally found that the group provided what it said was incorrect or misleading information linked to the terms of existing long-term wholesale access agreements.
The European Commission had unconditionally approved the deal in May 2024, but opened an investigation in July 2025 following complaints from third parties.
KKR said it disagreed with the commission's preliminary assessment.

"We stand by the accuracy of the information provided during the Commission's 2024 review of the NetCo acquisition," a KKR spokesperson said in a statement. "The statement of objections is not a final finding of infringement, and the Commission's existing clearance of the transaction remains valid," they said.
